name: CK资源
script: var site={name:"CK资源",api:"https://ckzy.me/api.php/provide/vod/",headers:{"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 16 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/16 Mobile Safari/605.1.15"}};async function home(){let res=await req(site.api+"?ac=list&pg=1",{headers:site.headers});let json=JSON.parse(res.content);let videos=[];if(json.list){json.list.forEach(v=>{videos.push({vod_id:v.vod_id,vod_name:v.vod_name,vod_pic:v.vod_pic,vod_remarks:v.vod_remarks||""})})}return {videos:videos}}async function category(page,cid){let url=site.api+"?ac=videolist&pg="+page+"&t="+(cid||"");let res=await req(url,{headers:site.headers});let json=JSON.parse(res.content);let videos=[];if(json.list){json.list.forEach(v=>{videos.push({vod_id:v.vod_id,vod_name:v.vod_name,vod_pic:v.vod_pic,vod_remarks:v.vod_remarks||""})})}return {videos:videos,page:page,pagecount:json.pagecount||1}}async function search(key,page){let url=site.api+"?ac=list&wd="+encodeURIComponent(key)+"&pg="+page;let res=await req(url,{headers:site.headers});let json=JSON.parse(res.content);let videos=[];if(json.list){json.list.forEach(v=>{videos.push({vod_id:v.vod_id,vod_name:v.vod_name,vod_pic:v.vod_pic,vod_remarks:v.vod_remarks||""})})}return {videos:videos,page:page,pagecount:json.pagecount||1}}async function detail(vod_id){let res=await req(site.api+"?ac=detail&ids="+vod_id,{headers:site.headers});let json=JSON.parse(res.content);let data=json.list[0];return {vod_id:data.vod_id,vod_name:data.vod_name,vod_pic:data.vod_pic,vod_content:data.vod_content||"",vod_actor:data.vod_actor||"",vod_director:data.vod_director||"",vod_play_from:data.vod_play_from,vod_play_url:data.vod_play_url}}async function play(flag,id){return {url:id}}
